entity_title: Dependent visa: work capped at 28 hours/week with permission
fact_text: A Japanese 'Dependent' (Kazoku Taizai / 家族滞在) visa holder may not work freely: they must first obtain 'Permission to Engage in Activity other than that Permitted' (shikakugai katsudo kyoka / 資格外活動許可). Under the comprehensive permission (包括許可) they may work at most 28 hours per week (1週について28時間以内).
evidence_quote: １週について２８時間以内の収入を伴う事業を運営する活動（注）又は報酬を受ける活動を行う場合は、資格外活動の包括許可が必要となります。

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a Dependent (spouse) can work freely. Actually they must first get 'permission to engage in activity other than that permitted' and may then work at most 28 hours/week. Action: apply for the extra-activity permission before the spouse takes any job.
